text:
Aisha (CS): quick heads-up — we need an incident-style outbound for a set of onboarding + renewal-risk tenants.
Aisha (CS): high level: during a model rollout a routing fallback sent some dedicated tenants to an older embedding model variant. that older model returns 1024-dim vectors while our index expects 1536. customers saw silent search failures and degraded ranking.
Aisha (CS): draft below — please review for technical accuracy and add mitigation + ETA. cc @Raj (Eng-ML) @Diego (Onboarding)

Aisha (CS): DRAFT CUSTOMER NOTE (short):
Hi — we’re reaching out to let you know we identified and mitigated an issue that affected embedding-based search for a subset of accounts during a recent model rollout. the problem caused inconsistent embedding sizes which led to missing or degraded search results. we rolled back the routing change and re-queued affected indexing jobs. we will follow up with a personalized impact summary and next steps. if you’d like a live walkthrough, we are scheduling office hours. apologies for the disruption. — Redwood CS

Raj (Eng-ML): technical confirm — correct summary. root cause: routing policy allowed fallback to legacy-embed-1024 when model tag mismatch occurred. mismatch surfaced when customers had pinned model 1.4 with new schema but fallback used 1.2.
Raj (Eng-ML): logs: saw headers like `X-Model-Variant: legacy-embed-1024` while index expects `embedding_dim:1536`. example error from logs: `IndexingError: vector length mismatch (expected 1536, got 1024)`
Raj (Eng-ML): mitigation done: reverted routing policy at 2023-09-25T18:12Z, triggered forced requeue for 42 affected tenants. running integrity check now. ETA for integrity pass: ~2h for small accounts, up to 8h for large ingest jobs.

Tom - CSM: thanks. need two things from eng: (1) canonical list of impacted tenants + severity flag (missing results vs. incorrect results) and (2) confirmation of reindex schedule so we can promise timing to customers.
Tom - CSM: I'll prep tailored emails for three buckets: trial (low touch), SMB (medium), enterprise/renewal-risk (high touch + phone).

Diego (Onboarding): can we get CSV of affected onboarding flows? several trials that just started are impacted. need to pause automated welcome emails that reference search until reindex done.

Ben (Support): creating support playbook now. will include: quick triage steps, how to collect affected query samples (`/api/queries?tenant_id=...&since=...`), and a standard credit offer template. also adding shared Zoom slot links for office hours.

Raj (Eng-ML): providing CSV in 10m. severity: 28 accounts with full indexing failures (no results), 14 with degraded ranking. reindexing work queue ID `requeue-4045` — progress published to: https://redwood.internal/ops/requeue-4045 (internal)

Aisha (CS): language tweak request — keep public note short and non-technical, point high-touch customers to a personalized follow-up. avoid mentioning dims in external copy.

Tom - CSM: got it. sample external: "We experienced an embedding routing issue affecting search for a small set of customers. We reverted the change and are reprocessing affected data. If you are impacted we’ll contact you with an account-specific timeline. For immediate help, reply to this thread or join office hours: <link>."

deploy-bot: rollback completed for routing-policy v1.9 -> v1.8 by @Raj (Eng-ML) at 2023-09-25T18:12Z :white_check_mark:

Aisha (CS): next steps: Raj to post final CSV + per-account ETA, Ben to finish playbook and credits phrasing, Diego/Tom to split outreach list and schedule office hours for enterprise wave. I'll send the short customer-facing blast once we have the CSV and ETAs.

Diego (Onboarding): scheduling two office-hour slots (EMEA friendly + APAC overlap). adding link to the external note for responses.

Ben (Support): support playbook link (internal): https://redwood.internal/kb/incident-4045-playbook. includes escalation matrix + sample credit wording.

Aisha (CS): thanks everyone — ping here when CSV and the first batch ETA are posted and I’ll dispatch the outbound. :pray:
